title: REQ · UI store exposes sound and settings flags with toggleSound and toggleSettings
summary: soundEnabled and settingsOpen flags with toggle actions are available from useUiStore.
description: Context: header needs sound toggle and settings. Desired behavior: useUiStore exposes soundEnabled (default true) and settingsOpen (default false) with toggleSound and toggleSettings. Expected result: each toggle flips only its own flag. Why: header sound and settings controls share state.
acceptance_criteria: Given initial state, when read, then soundEnabled is true and settingsOpen is false
Given the store, when toggleSound is called, then soundEnabled flips and settingsOpen, drawerOpen and modal are unchanged
Given the store, when toggleSettings is called, then settingsOpen flips and soundEnabled is unchanged
technical_constraints: Same store as drawer and modal
definition_of_done: Flags and actions implemented and typed
